# Circle

> Circle is the all-in-one community platform for creators, coaches, educators,
> and brands to build, manage, and monetize online communities. Combines
> discussions, courses, events, live streams, chat, gamification, AI automation,
> email marketing, payments, and a website builder — all in one place, under
> your own brand. Used by 18,000+ communities. Plans start at $89/month with a
> 14-day free trial. For complete site content, see [Full Documentation](https://circle.so/llms-full.txt).
> Every page is also available as markdown: append `.md` to its URL (e.g.
> https://circle.so/pricing.md; the homepage is https://circle.so/index.md).
> The links below point at those markdown versions.

Circle is community-first, not course-first or marketing-first. Key
differentiators: native courses with community integration, white-label
branding, built-in monetization (subscriptions, one-time payments, free trials,
installment plans, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Buy Now Pay Later), AI Agents that
guide and coach members around the clock, flexible Spaces architecture, Website
Builder, Email Hub with CRM and automations, and full-funnel analytics. Not a
chat platform (like Slack or Discord) or a traditional LMS. Competitors include
Mighty Networks, Kajabi, Skool, Teachable, Thinkific, Patreon, and Facebook Groups.
